data_partition.calibration: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 1; passive, ground-truth audit only
data_partition.selection: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 2
data_partition.confirmation: GOT-10k validation numeric sequence ID modulo 3 equals 0

frozen_policy.signal: abs(cx_mode - cx_mean) / width_midpoint from the native raw [left, top, right, bottom] coordinates
frozen_policy.threshold_source: calibration-only q95 from node14 passive raw-branch same-state audit
frozen_policy.action: when gated, replace only midpoint horizontal center with posterior-expectation horizontal center by applying the same offset to left and right corners
frozen_policy.host_sync: none beyond released final box conversion

selection_gate.proceed_to_confirmation_only_if: both requirements are satisfied on selection

b_test_policy: Never run B_test unless the frozen policy passes selection and confirmation.
